selection.edition: international Browserless Cloud REST API at production-sfo.browserless.io
selection.ownership: Browserless (browserless.io), United States (founder Joel Griffith; GitHub org lists USA). The reviewed edition is the public Cloud REST host production-sfo.browserless.io. Self-hosted Enterprise Docker/localhost is a different edition and is not this recipe.

research.searchCoverage: Official Browserless Cloud REST (token query parameter, POST /content alias of /chromium/content, POST /screenshot, POST /pdf, base https://production-sfo.browserless.io), pinned OpenConnector hardcoded SFO host and billed POST /content credential validator against https://example.com, US operator identity, and dated incident search (Browserless / browserless.io + security breach/incident) reviewed on 2026-09-13. Pinned source does not accept a caller-supplied host. Official docs also describe self-hosted Enterprise at the container host (default localhost:3000), which is a different edition. All pinned actions launch billed Chromium sessions. Official GET /proxy/cities is not a pinned upstream action and cannot be fabricated as healthcheck. AIKIDO-2025-10550 is a patched self-hosted log-redaction issue. This is not a breach-free claim.

research.edition: international Browserless Cloud REST API at production-sfo.browserless.io
research.searchCoverage: Official Cloud REST is https://production-sfo.browserless.io with ?token= authentication. Pinned OpenConnector hardcodes that host and validates credentials with billed POST /content. Self-hosted Enterprise uses the caller container host and is not this edition, so the Algolia stored-id + bounded-wildcard HOLD does not apply to the pinned cloud host. All pinned actions (content, screenshot, PDF) launch billed Chromium sessions and return HTML or binary, not JSON. Dated incident search on 2026-09-13 found no qualifying current unresolved Browserless Cloud customer-data compromise.

incidents.finding: AIKIDO-2025-10550 described token-like query parameters in @browserless.io/browserless logs for versions 2.0.0-2.33.0, patched in 2.34.0. That is a self-hosted package log-redaction issue, not a current unresolved Cloud customer-data compromise.
incidents.limitation: This is not a breach-free claim.

remainingGates: healthcheck: pinned credential validator is billed POST /content with url=https://example.com, which launches Chromium and consumes units. Official GET /proxy/cities is not a pinned upstream action and cannot be fabricated. There is no cheap authenticated JSON read in pinned actions.

operationQuality: POST /content returns text/html; POST /screenshot and POST /pdf return binary transit files. Native JSON contracts cannot express those responses. Screenshot and PDF also require transit file storage the native template cannot express.
research.waiverAuthority: User waiver dated 2026-09-13 permits historical non-China incident coverage. Pinned Browserless Cloud host is bounded; self-hosted Enterprise is a different edition.

adaptations: HOLD: billed Chromium content capture is not admitted as healthcheck. Native maps to documented POST /content?token= (official alias of /chromium/content) with required url.
Pinned source and current REST docs both use /content; OpenAPI also documents /chromium/content.
html XOR url, screenshot/PDF binary transit files, and wait/script injection options are omitted.
Token is the official query parameter. Authorization Basic token encoding is omitted.
Official response is text/html, not JSON. Native JSON wrapping is a placeholder only and is not admitted.

content.fetch.title: Fetch content
content.fetch.description: Would fetch rendered HTML with Browserless POST /content. This operation is billed and is not a healthcheck. Not admitted.
